selection_rule: select the whole data mesh or none; flush by the declared mask; empty selection has empty history
history_rule: use selected vertex/edge/face endpoints; vertex endpoints permit FIRST/LAST only when VERT mode is enabled; opposite endpoint uses a selected edge for first-only/last-only; other_none affects only the other data mesh

future_product_performance_proposal.basis: two existing class-A budgets of 250/2000 ms; freeze full attributed inputs and source results before a Rust multi-data extension; no timing result is claimed
